en.headline: 229 taxi drivers have incurred points under offence scheme, three disqualified
en.dek: As of early October, refusal of hire accounted for 125 of the cases under the Taxi-Driver-Offence Points system that took effect in September 2024.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan told the Legislative Council on Wednesday that 229 taxi drivers had incurred points under the Taxi-Driver-Offence Points regime as of 2 October 2026.
Of those cases, 125 involved refusal of hire, accounting for about 55 per cent. Three drivers have been disqualified from driving taxis for three months after reaching or exceeding 15 points.

From the scheme's start on 22 September 2024 until August 2026, the Transport Department received 5,944 taxi-related complaints, of which 605 concerned refusals of hire. Chan said cases are investigated and, where appropriate, referred to enforcement agencies or followed up with reminders to owners and drivers.

The government has declined calls to create separate stands for urban taxis at certain interchanges, saying the current arrangements are clearer for the public and that New Territories taxis will continue to serve their designated zones.

zh.headline: 的士司機違例記分制已有229人被記分 三人停牌
zh.dek: 截至10月初，拒載佔記分個案125宗；制度於2024年9月生效。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周三在立法會表示，的士司機違例記分制度截至2026年10月2日，共有229名的士司機被記分。
當中125宗涉及拒載，約佔55%。另有3名司機因累積15分或以上，已被取消駕駛的士資格三個月。
制度於2024年9月22日實施至2026年8月，運輸署共接獲5944宗與的士司機有關的投訴，其中605宗涉及拒載。陳美寶指，投訴會調查，並視情況轉交執法部門或去信提醒車主及司機。
政府拒絕在部分交匯處劃分市區的士專用站的建議，指現有安排較清晰，新界的士亦會繼續服務其指定營業範圍。
